pages.text: Julia has a play house in her backyard. It is pink, with a green roof.
pages.picture: a small plastic playhouse, pink with a green roof

pages.text: "Toby, you can hide in here," she said. Toby just fits.
pages.picture: the dragon squeezed inside the little playhouse

pages.text: "Now I must go in and eat," said Julia. "Wait here!"
pages.picture: girl waving and running to the house

pages.text: Julia eats toast and jam. Then she runs back to the play house.
pages.picture: girl eating toast and jam at the kitchen table

pages.text: But her scooter is on its side, and the wheel is bent!
pages.picture: a scooter lying on its side with a bent wheel
the girl with hands on hips

pages.text: Toby looks at his feet. "I miss my mum. I get upset, and things float up. Then they crash down."
Julia stamps her foot. "That is my best scooter!" She stomps off into the house.
Toby sits in the play house. He is so sad that the cups and dolls lift up, just a bit, and bob there.
pages.picture: toy cups and dolls drifting gently in the air around the sad dragon
